title: Porsche Newsroom Canada: Model year 2027 Porsche Taycan updates (e-shift, native NACS port)
notes: 2027 Taycan (all but Turbo GT with Weissach Package) gets a NACS DC port on the passenger-side fender; driver-side port stays J1772 AC; "A CCS adapter will be provided." Page says vehicle data refers to the German market. No heat pump mention.
